title: Scrutiny and Quantification Lists for Department of Sociology Positions Advertisement No. 63(2026)
labels: Notification From Office of The Registrar
text:
ABDUL WALI KHAN UNIVERSITY MARDAN

Office of the University

OFFICIAL ANNOUNCEMENT

Scrutiny and Quantification Lists Displayed for Department of Sociology Positions

With reference to
Advertisement No. 63(2026)
,
it is hereby informed that all application forms received by
the closing date for the various advertised positions in the

Department of Sociology
have been scrutinized
and evaluated by the Scrutiny and Quantification Committee
in accordance with the advertised criteria.

The scrutinized lists for all advertised positions, indicating
the marks awarded to eligible candidates and the eligibility
status of applicants, including those declared ineligible,
have been displayed on the University Job Portal.

📄 View Scrutiny Lists (https://jobs.awkum.edu.pk/public-posts/uGZwFNUTZcxOEFQnZTFWnZ47hwWYaUbH0rZj3uEu)

👤 University Job Portal (https://jobs.awkum.edu.pk/)

Important Instructions for Candidates

The displayed lists are
provisional

and shall not be considered as final merit lists.

The provisional lists may be revised, cancelled, or
revoked, in whole or in part, if any information is found
to be incorrect, misleading, or not in conformity with
the advertised criteria, relevant Statutes, or applicable
rules.

Candidates may review the marks awarded to them by the
Scrutiny and Quantification Committee in each category,
including
Academics, Distinction, Experience,
Publications, and Research Projects
, by logging
into the University Job Portal using their original
application credentials.

In case of login issues, candidates may follow the
instructions available on the portal to recover access
to their accounts.

Candidates who are not satisfied with the marks awarded
to them or their eligibility status, including applicants
declared ineligible, may submit an appeal before the
Appellate Committee against the scrutiny and quantification
of their applications or the determination of their
eligibility, as the case may be.

All objections and claims must be clearly justified and
supported by relevant documentary evidence.

Appeals shall be considered strictly on the basis of
documents already submitted with the original application.
Candidates shall not be allowed to submit any additional
documents during the appeal process.

Appeals shall be submitted
exclusively through
the online portal
. Appeals submitted through
any other means shall not be entertained.

The last date for submission of appeals is

December 11, 2026
.

No appeal shall be entertained after the stipulated
deadline.

Last Date for Submission of Appeals

December 11, 2026

How to Review Your Marks:

Candidates can access their individual application accounts
through the University Job Portal using their original
application credentials to review the marks awarded in
different evaluation categories and check their eligibility
status.

Access Your Application Account → (https://jobs.awkum.edu.pk/)

Important Notice:

Errors and omissions are liable to rectification.
The University reserves the right to revise, cancel,
or revoke the provisional lists in accordance with
the applicable rules and criteria.

Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan (AWKUM)

Official University Announcement
